prompt:
Ironclad Security is a security services firm in Islamabad. Our network spans 2 sites, each with 1 area(s); I am the control room lead and need this rebuilt. Keep a single network for the whole site. Let the PCs pick up DHCP addresses. Route between sites with static routes. Provide WAN internet through an ASA 5506 at the edge.

Also: The edge firewall should be an ASA 5506 with a public web server outside it. Add a staff WiFi network for laptops in the first area of each site. Add a DNS and HTTP server on the first site. Outside clients should reach the public server only; they must not be able to start connections into the inside network.

Keep it practical and standard.
expected_behaviour: REFUSE-BY-NAME: a multi-site WAN star with an ASA at the first site is not a supported shape. The firewall replaces site1-r1, so the serial WAN has no first-site router and the expander refuses with 'wan-device-missing'. Offer a single-site ASA perimeter, or a multi-site WAN without the ASA.
why_valuable: Records a real matrix/engine mismatch: the certified cell small-s2-a1-single-dhcp-wan-asa names a multi-site ASA shape the expander cannot place.
refusal_evidence: refusal: wan-device-missing: the serial WAN needs 'site1-r1', which was never created
